description: Two crossing movements, seeded arrivals and fixed-time signals. Vehicles accelerate, queue and discharge along links and connectors.
invalidSeed: Enter an integer seed from 0 to 4294967295.
SCENARIO_FILE_READ: Cannot read this file, or it is not valid JSON.
SCENARIO_NOT_JSON_OBJECT: This file is not a JSON object, so it is neither a scenario nor a project.
SCENARIO_NO_NETWORK: This file has no "network" section. It is not a TrafficSim scenario or project.
SCENARIO_NO_DEFINITION: This file has no "definition" section, so there is nothing to run. A runnable scenario needs duration, timeStep, routes, inputs and signalPrograms.
SCENARIO_IS_PROJECT: This is a Network Editor project, not a runnable scenario. A drawn network has no simulation definition yet — routes, vehicle inputs and signal programs — so this window cannot run it. Open it in the Network Editor instead.
editorScope: Network Editor · Run uses an explicit document revision. Not yet validated: reduced Wiedemann-inspired prototype; no conflict resolution, lane changing or LOS.
editorNoSelection: Select a link or connector, or draw a new link.
editorHelp: Choose a Network Object and Ctrl + right-drag to create it. Click points and Enter traces a link. Ctrl + click adds to selection; Ctrl + drag a selected object duplicates the selection. Delete removes objects; Ctrl + Delete removes a point.
editorDeleteWarning: Delete this link and its attached connectors, signal heads, affected routes and their vehicle inputs? Undo restores them together.
editorError: The edit could not be completed:
EDIT_LANES: Use 1–12 lanes with positive widths. Marking lists need N+1 boundaries for a Link or N−1 dividers for a Connector; blank restores defaults.
EDIT_REFERENCED_LANE: This lane is referenced by a connector or a signal head. Remove those references before reducing the lane count. A route does not block it: a route names the link, not its lanes.
EDIT_SPLIT_RANGE: Choose a split more than 0.2 m from either end.
EDIT_SPLIT_SIGNAL: Splitting a link with signal heads is not available yet. The original document was kept.
EDIT_BACKGROUND_INVALID: Cannot use this image or transform. Use a valid image up to 32 megapixels and a positive scale.
EDIT_NO_NETWORK: This file has no "network" section, so there is nothing to open.
EDIT_VERSION: This project version is not supported.
EDIT_FILE_READ: Cannot read the project file (limit: 48 MB).
EDIT_FILE_WRITE: Could not save. Your changes remain unsaved; the existing file was not replaced.
EDIT_ID_LIMIT: The project ID counter is invalid or exhausted.
EDIT_GAP: The carriageway gap must be zero or positive.
INVALID_GEOMETRY: Use at least two distinct points with a positive finite length.
editorDeleteConnectorWarning: Delete this connector, affected routes and their vehicle inputs? Undo restores them together.
editorPickSourceLane: Click a lane anywhere along the source link.
editorPickTargetLane: Click a lane anywhere along the target link. Esc cancels.
editorConnectorCanvasHint: Choose Connect lanes (C) and pick positions on the source and target links.
editorConnectorHelp: Pick positions on links or Ctrl + right-drag between them. Select (S): orange lane tabs on both sides of source/target resize each lane range; middle tabs set both counts together. Drag outward to add lanes, inward to remove them; the number in the tab is the resulting count. White points on the middle of the connector edit the curve, and the dark end points drag onto another lane or another position along it. A narrower target keeps only the lanes that fit. Ctrl + Delete removes a point.
EDIT_CONNECTOR_LANES: Choose both the source and target lanes.
EDIT_CONNECTOR_ENDPOINTS: Connector endpoints stay attached to lanes. Use from / to to change the lane references.
EDIT_CONNECTOR_GAP: The attachment positions coincide. Choose two distinct positions for the connector.
EDIT_REFERENCED_CONNECTOR: A signal head stands on this connector. Its lane references cannot change until the head is moved or removed. You can still reshape the curve, and routes never block the change.
DUPLICATE_CONNECTION: These lanes already have a connector. Select the existing connector to edit it.
UNKNOWN_LANE: The selected lane does not exist. Choose a current lane.
editorDeleteSelectedWarning: Delete the selected links, connectors and signal heads, together with dependent connectors, heads, routes and vehicle inputs? One Undo restores all of them.
editorSelectionCount: %1 objects selected. Property edits act on the last one selected.
editorNoProblems: No problems found. A committed drawing is always valid, so this list fills when an edit is rejected or a runnability check finds something.
editorRuntimeNote: Runnability findings never block authoring or saving. They report what the M0 simulation core cannot run yet; they are not a fidelity check.
editorTablesHelp: Select a row to select and frame that object. Ctrl-click adds objects; Ctrl-drag selected objects on the canvas duplicates them. Drag a box to select several. Double-click a problem to jump to its object.
EDIT_NO_DEFINITION: This project has no simulation definition yet, so only the network topology was checked. Demand authoring arrives with M2.
EDIT_NO_CATALOG: Vehicle type and driver behaviour references were not checked: those catalogs live in data/, not in the project file.
EDIT_RUNTIME_SKIPPED: The runnability check was skipped because the drawing has unresolved problems above. Fix those first.
EDIT_UNKNOWN_OBJECT: This problem does not name an object that can be shown on the canvas.
INVALID_ID: This object needs a non-blank ID.
DUPLICATE_ID: Two objects share this ID. IDs must be unique across the whole network.
DISCONNECTED_GEOMETRY: The connector no longer meets its lane end. Reset the curve, or reattach it to current lanes.
NO_LANES: This link has no lanes. Give it at least one.
INVALID_WIDTH: Lane width must be a finite value greater than zero, in metres.
INVALID_POSITION: The signal head sits beyond its lane. Move it back within the lane length.
EMPTY_NETWORK: Nothing has been drawn yet. This is a valid draft, not an error.
INVALID_DRIVING_SIDE: drivingSide must be left or right.
UNSUPPORTED_MERGE: Two or more paths feed this lane. The M0 simulation core has no merge arbitration yet, so it cannot run this. Authoring it is allowed.
UNSUPPORTED_ROUTE_CYCLE: A route passes through the same segment twice. The M0 core does not run repeated segments.
UNSUPPORTED_INTERNAL_INPUT: This vehicle input starts on a segment that already has traffic feeding it. The M0 core only accepts inputs at network entry points.
UNKNOWN_SEGMENT: A route refers to a lane or connector that no longer exists.
DISCONNECTED_ROUTE: Consecutive route steps are not connected. Add the missing connector, or revise the route.
INVALID_NUMBER: This value must be a finite number greater than zero.
INVALID_RANGE: The lower bound of this range must not exceed the upper bound.
INVALID_INTERVAL: The interval ends before it starts. Check startTime and endTime.
TIMESTEP_TOO_LARGE: timeStep must be 0.5 s or less for car-following to remain stable.
OFF_TIME_GRID: This time is not a whole multiple of timeStep.
UNKNOWN_ROUTE: This refers to a route that does not exist.
UNKNOWN_VEHICLE_TYPE: This refers to a vehicle type that does not exist in the loaded catalog.
UNKNOWN_BEHAVIOUR: This refers to a driver behaviour that does not exist in the loaded catalog.
UNKNOWN_SIGNAL_PROGRAM: This refers to a signal program that does not exist.
EMPTY_SIGNAL_PROGRAM: This signal program has no phases.
INVALID_SIGNAL_COLOR: A signal phase colour must be red, amber or green.
editorDeleteDemandWarning: Delete this object? Deleting a route also removes its vehicle inputs. Undo restores the whole change.
editorRouteSegments: Links and connectors in travel order
editorRouteHelp: Choose a starting link, then append connected links and connectors in travel order. Remove last to revise the path. On the canvas, the Routes tool draws the same route: click the start, then click each destination. A route covers every lane of the links it names.
editorRouteClickHelp: Route tool: click the start link, then click a destination. Enter or double-click stores the route, Backspace removes the last object, Esc cancels. The route covers every lane.
editorInputPlaceHelp: Vehicle inputs tool: click the link traffic enters on. The volume is the link total, split across its lanes.
editorInputNeedsRoute: No route starts on this link. Draw one now?
editorRunReady: Author routes and inputs, then Run.
editorRunStatus: Revision %1 · seed %2 · %3 s · active %4 · pending %5 · completed %6 · mean delay %7 s · safety clamps %8
editorRunStatusNote: Mean trip delay counts source waiting and acceleration, for completed trips only. Safety clamps count the steps where the prototype car-following had to be bounded. Diagnostics, not HCM control delay or LOS.
EDIT_REFERENCED_PROGRAM: This program is used by a signal head. Reassign or delete the head first.
EDIT_CATALOG_READ: Could not read vehicle or driver catalogs. Check the selected data directory and JSON files.
EDIT_NO_INPUTS: Add a route and vehicle input before running this project.
EDIT_HEAD_REFERENCE: Choose either a lane or a connector for a signal head, not both.
editorRecovered: Recovered as an unsaved project. Save to choose its destination.
editorRecoveryFound: Unsaved work from a previous session is available. Review recovery copies?
EDIT_RECOVERY_LOCK: This recovery copy is in use by another editor.
EDIT_FILE_FORMAT: The file is not a valid TrafficSim JSON document.
EDIT_FILE_TOO_LARGE: The project exceeds the 48 MB file limit.
editorConnectorWidths: Lane widths (m, comma-separated; blank = from links)
editorGestureHelp: Ctrl + right-drag: create Link or Connector. Select (S): orange handles on either side add/remove lanes while the opposite edge stays fixed. Ctrl + click: add to selection. Ctrl + drag selected objects: duplicate. Delete: objects. Ctrl + Delete: vertex.
EDIT_LANE_RANGE: The connector lane range must fit within both links (1–12 lanes).
EDIT_DISPLAY_VALUE: Use a valid level and a nonempty display type.
EDIT_NAME_LENGTH: A name is at most 200 characters.
EDIT_DISPLAY_CATALOG: Could not read the levels or display types in the data directory.
EDIT_DUPLICATE_LINKS: Select at least one link to duplicate. Internal connectors and heads are copied with their links.
EDIT_CONNECTOR_POSITION: Connector position must be a finite distance in metres between the start and the end of its link.
EDIT_CREATION_TARGET: No object was created. Draw a link with a nonzero length, or release the connector on a visible target link.
EDIT_SPLIT_ATTACHMENT: The split would cut through a connector attachment. Move the split at least 0.1 m away from that position.
EDIT_NO_PRIORITY_DEFAULTS: This network has a connector arriving inside a link body, which is a merge, and the gap time and headway that arbitrate it could not be read from the data directory. Drawing, saving and editing are supported; Run needs data/priority-rules/ to be present.
UNSUPPORTED_CONNECTOR_POSITION: This connector leaves a link body too close to the end of the lane, or to another connector on the same lane, to leave a section either side of it. Drawing, saving and editing are supported; move it at least 0.2 m clear to run it.
UNSUPPORTED_ROUTE_TOPOLOGY: This route's links and connectors do not join up for a single lane, so no vehicle can travel it. Drawing, saving and editing are supported; connect the objects it names, or name the connector between them, to run it.
WARN_CONNECTOR_ALIGNMENT: The Connector reaches a Link too steeply or against its direction. A full-width square mouth is shown where lane alignment is impossible. Reset the curve or move the intermediate points/attachments to approach in the direction of travel.
TIGHT_CONNECTOR_RADIUS: This connector turns tighter than its own width, so no vehicle could follow it. The drawing is kept and Run is not blocked; widen the turn or move the attachments apart.
EDIT_COPY_TARGET: Place copied Connector endpoints or signal heads on existing lanes at the same level. No objects were copied. Select both parent Links to copy the whole connection.
EDIT_MOVE_TARGET: Select at least one Link or Connector to move. Signal heads move with their parent road.
editorLinkMarkings: Boundary markings in lane order (N+1; solid/dashed/none/double; blank = defaults)
EDIT_LINK_STATION: Choose a finite station strictly between the Link endpoints.
EDIT_REFERENCED_LINK: Cannot reverse a Link used by a Connector or a signal head. Remove those references first. A route does not block it: a route names the link, not its lanes.
EDIT_UNSUPPORTED_FIELD: This project contains a field this version does not support. See the problem path; opening was cancelled to avoid losing data.
INVALID_MARKING: Use solid, dashed, none or double for each marking.
WARN_SHORT_CONNECTOR: Connector is shorter than 5 m. Check the geometry; this advisory does not block Run or Save.
editorHistoryHelp: Double-click a state or press Enter to restore it. Up to 100 edits are kept for this session.
EDIT_HISTORY_REVISION: This history state is no longer available. Choose a state from the current list.
editorKeyboardHelp: Select (S): arrow keys move selected Links/Connectors by the grid interval (1 m with Snap off); Shift moves ten intervals. Ctrl+Shift+H opens History. Alt + left-drag rotates the selection; hold Shift for 15° steps. Ctrl+Shift+R enters an exact angle.
editorRotationHelp: Angle in degrees around the centre of the selected roads. Positive turns counter-clockwise; negative turns clockwise. Connectors that leave their parent roads are removed with their dependent routes and heads; Undo restores the whole edit.
EDIT_ROTATE_TARGET: Select at least one Link or Connector to rotate. Signal heads rotate with their parent road.
editorInputSplitHelp: The volume is the whole link's total. It is divided equally across the lanes the route reaches — an authoring convenience, not a lane-choice model: this engine has no lane changing, and none of these figures are validated.
